headline: Taiwan Semiconductor Industry Electricity Use Hits Record High
summary: Electricity consumption by Taiwan's semiconductor industry topped 4.5 terawatt-hours for the first time last month, driven by stronger-than-expected AI demand.
why: Taiwan is a critical hub for global semiconductor manufacturing, housing major foundries like TSMC. Energy consumption metrics serve as a proxy for chip production volume and AI hardware demand.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Record high power usage signals surging operational output to meet artificial intelligence hardware demand.
